plain_text:
The myth of the paperless office may be just that. But there
are many ways you can reduce paper use that benefit you, your
business bottom line, and the environment. This guide provides
tips and tools for office workers and managers in business,
government, and other organizations. You will find steps to
reduce paper at your desk, in the mail room, by using new
technologies, and in many other ways. See how smarter paper-
buying choices can reduce cost and waste.

plain_text:
You may already be steps ahead in reducing paper use and
purchases in your office. This guide is designed to help you —
whether you don't know where to begin or you are looking for
ideas to further advance your paper reduction efforts. Take a look
and see if there might be more you and your coworkers can do
to make a difference.

plain_text:
Waste Prevention. It's a simple concept: Waste prevention means not creating waste
in the first place. If you create less waste, you consume fewer resources and don't
have to spend as much money to recycle or dispose of your waste.
